collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ADVICE AND DECISIONS (ADV-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Asking for advice, giving it, ignoring it, following half of it, and deciding alone. Advice can be wrong, even from elders and experts. Following it doesn't guarantee a good outcome and ignoring it doesn't cause a bad one. Feeling heard with no decision is a perfectly good ending, and nobody ever has to admit someone else was right.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager asks if they should trade a spear for yams, then admits they already did: laugh, or reassure them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) comes to (friend) with a question: "Should I trade my old fishing spear for a basket of yams?" (friend) thinks about it carefully, weighs it up and says, "Hmm. It's a good spear. I'd keep it." (subject) nods slowly. "That's useful," (subject.he/she) says. "I traded it this morning."

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (friend) stares at (subject.him/her), then bursts out laughing. "Then why are you asking me?" (subject) shrugs. "I wanted to know if I'd done something silly." "Well, you did," says (friend). "But they're probably good yams." They are, in fact, very good yams. (subject) shares them with (friend), which helps.

o1__text.name: Outcome A
o1__text.text: (friend) stares at (subject.him/her), then bursts out laughing. "Then why are you asking me?" (subject) shrugs. "I wanted to know if I'd done something silly." "Well, you did," says (friend). "But they're probably good yams." They are, in fact, very good yams. (subject) shares them with (friend), which helps.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "Well," says (friend) quickly, "it's done now. And you can always make another spear." (subject) nods. "That's what I thought." (subject.He/she) seems a lot happier. (friend) realizes (subject) didn't really want advice. (subject.He/she) wanted someone to tell (subject.him/her) it was alright. And it is alright. Mostly. It was a good spear.
